function.name: search_catalogue
function.description: Search the watch catalogue with structured filters. Use this to find watches matching what the customer described (budget, gender, style, strap, size, etc.). Returns a short list of matching watches with product IDs. Never guess product IDs; get them from this tool.

query.description: Optional keywords for anything the filters don't cover: a collection or model name, colour, case material (titanium, steel, ceramic), glass (sapphire), functions (chronograph, date, open heart), luminous hands. Leave out generic words like 'watch'.

gender.description: Who the watch is for. 'men' and 'women' also return unisex watches.

water_resistance_min_m.description: Minimum water resistance in metres (50 for showering, 100 for swimming).

in_stock_only.description: Only return watches in stock at this store. Default false.

function.name: get_product_details
function.description: Get the full specifications, price, warranty and colour variants of one watch.

product_id.description: A product ID (SKU) such as '1001SL01', or a style ID such as 'V1001'.

function.name: compare_products
function.description: Compare two or three watches side by side on their specifications and price.

attributes.description: Optional list of attributes to compare, e.g. ['mrp', 'water_resistance_m']. Omit to compare all key attributes.

function.name: check_inventory
function.description: Check whether a watch is in stock at this store, and which nearby stores have it. Use whenever the customer asks about availability, colours in stock, or trying a watch on.

colour.description: Optional dial or strap colour, used to pick the right variant when a style ID is given.

store_id.description: Store to check. Defaults to this store.

function.name: get_alternatives
function.description: Suggest 2-3 alternative watches that are in stock at this store: when the requested one is out of stock, when the customer wants something cheaper, or for similar styles.

function.name: call_staff
function.description: Call a store staff member to the kiosk. Use when the customer wants to try on or buy a watch, needs service, or asks something you cannot answer from the catalogue or store documents.

product_id.description: Optional product the customer is interested in.

note.description: Optional short note for the staff member.
